description: This file contains Python code for generating template values for WebIDL interfaces in Blink, including handling of constants, attributes, methods, overloads, and interface contexts.

methods.name: filter_has_constant_configuration
methods.description: Filters constants that have no measure, deprecate, runtime enabled, or origin trial attributes.

methods.name: filter_has_special_getter
methods.description: Filters constants that have measure or deprecate attributes.

methods.name: filter_runtime_enabled
methods.description: Filters constants that have runtime enabled feature attribute.

methods.name: filter_origin_trial_enabled
methods.description: Filters constants that have origin trial feature attribute.

methods.name: constant_filters
methods.description: Returns a dict of constant filter functions.

methods.name: origin_trial_features
methods.description: Returns list of origin trial features used in an interface, with 'name' and 'needs_instance'.

methods.name: interface_context
methods.description: Creates a Jinja template context for an interface, including includes, attributes, methods, constants, and other interface properties.

methods.name: methods_context
methods.description: Creates list of method contexts for an interface, including overloads and special methods.

methods.name: reflected_name
methods.description: Converts an all-uppercase constant name to a camel-case 'kConstantName'.

methods.name: constant_context
methods.description: Creates a context dict for a constant, including its type, name, value, and attributes.

methods.name: compute_method_overloads_context
methods.description: Computes overload info for methods, separated by static and non-static.

methods.name: compute_method_overloads_context_by_type
methods.description: Adds overload info to methods with the same name, for a given set of methods.

methods.name: overloads_context
methods.description: Returns overload template values for a set of overloads with the same name.

methods.name: distinguishing_argument_index
methods.description: Calculates the index of the argument that distinguishes overloads.

methods.name: length_tests_methods
methods.description: Returns list of overload resolution tests by argument length.

methods.name: resolution_tests_methods
methods.description: Yields resolution tests and methods for overloads of a given length.

methods.name: common
methods.description: Returns common result of applying function f to all dicts, or None.

methods.name: common_key
methods.description: Checks if all dicts have a key, returns True/False/None.

methods.name: common_value
methods.description: Checks if all dicts have the same value for a key.

methods.name: constructor_context
methods.description: Creates context dict for a constructor, including arguments and exception info.

methods.name: named_constructor_context
methods.description: Creates context for a named constructor if present.

methods.name: number_of_required_arguments
methods.description: Counts non-optional arguments in a constructor.

methods.name: interface_length
methods.description: Determines the minimal number of required constructor arguments.

methods.name: legacy_caller
methods.description: Creates context for a legacy caller method if present.

methods.name: property_getter
methods.description: Creates context for a property getter, including type checks and return value.

methods.name: property_setter
methods.description: Creates context for a property setter, including type checks.

methods.name: property_deleter
methods.description: Creates context for a property deleter.
